cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 51 since 2006. Worked for the Birmingham Police Department from 1989, finishing as assistant chief, and retired in September 2020. Former president of the Birmingham Fraternal Order of Police.
cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace, where he was raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no documented positions on data centers or development, and no statements or deeds on homestead taxes, land ownership, immigration, gun laws, abortion or education. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys, and Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026. The Ballotpedia sponsored-legislation table was empty in the text we received, so we could not identify bills he sponsored. No controversies were found in the pages we had.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2006 (20 years), and 31 years with the Birmingham Police Department, ending as assistant chief. Also served on the Birmingham Retirement and Relief System Board and as president of the Birmingham Fraternal Order of Police.
qual.why: Two decades of prior legislative service rates high on the rubric. Committee chairing and board seats add nothing. His long law enforcement career, including a senior command role, is real-world work but not a law, policy or budget career.
